title: Restore
description: Replace the whole application database with the contents of a backup file. Only an ADMIN can restore data.
restarting: The database was restored. The application is restarting; please sign in again.
flushFailed: Draft changes are not saved yet, so the restore did not start. Check the draft that failed to save and try again.

preview.title: Backup preview: {{fileName}}
preview.warning: All current data will be replaced with the contents of this backup. Transactions made after this backup will no longer be in the application.
preview.safetyNote: A safety backup of the current data is made automatically before restoring. Invoice numbers already used are never reused.
